Description.ExtraCommonChaosChoices: Extra choices for common chaos, added to the vanilla count and talent bonuses. Default: 3. Minimum: 0. Zero adds no choices. Capped at this rarity's pool; choose one reward. Applies to newly generated shrines.
Description.ExtraRareChaosChoices: Independent extra choices for rare chaos. Default: 3. Minimum: 0. Added to the vanilla count and talent bonuses, capped at this rarity's pool. Choose one reward.
Description.ExtraEpicChaosChoices: Independent extra choices for epic chaos. Default: 3. Minimum: 0. Added to the vanilla count and talent bonuses, capped at this rarity's pool. Choose one reward.
Description.ExtraLegendaryChaosChoices: Independent extra choices for legendary chaos. Default: 3. Minimum: 0. Added to the vanilla count and talent bonuses, capped at this rarity's pool. Choose one reward.
Description.ExtraCorruptedChaosChoices: Independent extra choices for corrupted chaos. Default: 3. Minimum: 0. Added to the vanilla count and talent bonuses, capped at eligible rewards. Choose one reward. Only the host's settings apply.
